newsitem.title: USA: US agency clears way for AMR pilot strike.
newsitem.headline: US agency clears way for AMR pilot strike.

text.p: The National Mediation Board set the stage Wednesday for a possible strike by pilots at AMR Corp.'s American Airines at 12:01 a.m. (0501 GMT) on Feb. 15, a spokesman for the agency said.
The agency, which mediates labor disputes in the airline and railroad industries, issued a letter Wednesday that started a 30-day "cooling off," spokesman Harry Bickford said.
Bickford said the agency started the "cooling off" period after the Forth Worth, Texas-based carrier on Wednesday withdrew an earlier offer to accept binding arbitration to resolve the dispute.

American had made its brief arbitration acceptance conditional on the APA agreeing to it by Wednesday. Bickford said the agency had received no communications from the APA accepting the arbitration alternative by Wednesday.

Labor disputes cannot be resolved by arbitration unless both parties agree to the process. Last Week APA members rejected a contract that union leaders had endorsed, which would have raised pilots' pay by about 5 percent over four years.
